test_overview: Evaluated the same-device endorsement signing flow in the Pilot's Logbook app against the 6-step plan. Server and seeded accounts were healthy. Step 1 (setup accounts/lesson flight) PASSED: pilot login, aircraft N222LF (Cessna 172S, Airplane/SEL), and a lesson flight dated 2026-08-08 (D0) KRHV->KOAK with the specified times/landings, lesson ON and notes; row shows lesson + 'Unsigned' endorsement and an 'Endorse' action. Step 2 (pilot initiates signing) PASSED: clicking Endorse opened a blocking 'Endorse Lesson Flight' modal in the same browser context with an Instructor Sign In form, a read-only flight summary, and PRD-consistent 'pilot session paused' notice; background pilot controls were inoperable. Step 3 (instructor sees signing view) FAILED FATALLY: after entering instructor credentials and clicking 'Continue as Instructor' exactly once, the app navigated AWAY to the standalone Instructor Dashboard (/instructor) and destroyed the endorse modal; the read-only flight summary and signing UI (attestation checkbox, comment, password re-entry, sign button) never appeared and are not reachable within one obvious navigation action (the dashboard only lists issued endorsements, 'No endorsements yet', with no pending-signing entry). Browser Back stayed on /instructor; reproduced on a clean re-run. Steps 4, 5 and 6 were NOT performed because the Step 3 fatal failure makes the signing UI inaccessible, so no endorsement could be created via the same-device flow and no VERIFY_URL was obtainable. Total score: 16/54.
